name: Andirá (Brazil)
description: Divided per saltire green at the top and bottom and red at the hoist and fly, the divisions marked by a saltire of white and yellow stripes, charged at the centre with the municipal arms.
history: Andirá is a municipality in the state of Paraná, Brazil. The flag was adopted in 1968 (designed by Arcinóe Antonio Peixoto de Faria and instituted by Municipal Law No. 354 of 1968, the arms having been adopted by Law No. 353 of 11 December 1968, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: saltire of white and yellow stripes
municipal arms with a mural crown, a map and sugar cane, reading ANDIRÁ
